item.nusmp.heros_shield.desc: An ice-blue kite shield with a silver maze and a glowing gem. +3 armour, steadier on your feet, and nonmagical weapons strike you 25% softer. Hold use to raise it like a shield; sneak and use (or the worn-relic key) hurls it at a foe (6 blocks, 18 at a disadvantage); it bashes hard in melee.
